LOCAL ENGINE REQUIRED

Run the engine on your machine.

This hosted page explores reports. Launch the local workbench to scan JARs without an API key. Model proposals and subsequent source analysis require a configured provider credential.

python workbench.py --java-home /path/to/target-jdk
Open local workbench ↗

To enable JAR scans, restart the server with --java-home /path/to/target-jdk (any JDK version). Keep JDK 17+ on PATH to run the analysis backend.

Advanced settings
Supported archives and limits

Up to 64 archives, 256 MiB combined. Nested libraries are extracted. Point --java-home at a JDK matching your target (Java 8, 11, 17 or newer); classes the chosen runtime cannot load are reported, not scanned. Missing dependencies limit coverage.

Runs locally. No model calls with built-in rules.

Getting started

01

Prepare the engine

Clone the repository. Install Python 3.10+ dependencies and JDK 17 for Flash.

git clone https://github.com/MarkLee131/GadgetHunter.git
cd GadgetHunter
git switch modern-scanning
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

The workbench, triage and modern profiles live on the modern-scanning branch until they are merged.

02

Generate candidates

The command selects native callbacks and built-in taint rules automatically for the target you point it at. This stage requires no API key.

python scan_candidates.py \
  --app /path/application.jar \
  --lib /path/dependency.jar \
  --java-home /path/target-jdk \
  --output /path/new-scan \
  --timeout 300 --heap-mb 4096

Review stage1.json for coverage and missing prerequisites. A partial scan retains available candidates in chains. Package matching target and dependency Java sources into a ZIP for the next step.

03

Open your workbench

The browser can also generate candidates directly from JAR uploads. Configure the target runtime (any JDK version) once when starting the server. Set a model credential only for model proposals or source analysis.

export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key"
python workbench.py --java-home /path/target-jdk
Open http://127.0.0.1:8765 ↗

Upload target/dependency JARs, review scan coverage, then choose Analyze candidates and supply matching Java sources as a ZIP. Existing chains files can be uploaded directly.

04

Review, then verify

Inspect call edges, extracted constraints, and unresolved evidence. Resume interrupted jobs from the overview. Export JSON to review in this hosted page without uploading it.

FEASIBLESatisfiable under the extracted model; independently verify the application context.UNKNOWNMissing or unsupported evidence. This is not a negative result.
